jobs.occupation: QEHS Manager wanted for Belden Cekan
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the one who makes quality, safety and the environment go together in everyday life – not just on paper, but out on the floor? Do you thrive on creating structure, asking the right questions and driving improvements that can be both measured and felt? And do you want to help lift our certifications, EHS programs and environmental initiatives in an international manufacturing company? Then you might be our new QEHS Manager.

About the role

We are looking for a committed colleague for our factory in Gjern, Central Jutland. This is a role where you will be a central focal point between production, R&D, management and the rest of the organisation when it comes to ensuring high standards and continuous improvements.

As a QEHS Manager you will work as part of a matrix organisation, reporting directly to the factory manager on-site and to the Q and EHS Managers EMEA respectively in a dotted line. This position makes you part of the management team and has one direct report.

You will make a difference in the following ways

• Developing, evaluating, improving and implementing a new integrated management system at Belden Cekan.

• Securing necessary certifications such as ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001 and upcoming projects such as ISO 45001 in collaboration with external authorities.

• Conducting internal audits and supplier audits to ensure compliance with standards.

• Handling complaints and collaborating with R&D and production management on corrective actions.

• Supporting production by monitoring and auditing quality systems and initiating improvement initiatives.

• Responsibility for the Quality Room, including layout, equipment and procedures.

• Planning and execution of calibration programs and archiving systems for product specifications.

• Participation in the health and safety committee and lean projects for continuous improvement.

• Responsibility for reporting ESG data as well as quality and safety to the remaining group.

What you bring

We are looking for a candidate who can combine structure with impact while thriving on working close to both people and processes. You have an eye for detail, but can also lift your gaze and see connections across the board.

You might be an ideal fit if you:

• Have experience with quality, safety and environmental management, preferably from a manufacturing company.

• Are certified or have solid knowledge of ISO standards.

• Are fluent in English, both orally and in writing.

• Have strong communication and collaboration skills across departments and countries.

• Work in a structured, analytical and proactive manner with problem solving and improvements.

What we can offer you

You will have a key position in an international company with strong values, where quality, employee safety and environmental responsibility are prioritized as essential parts of running a factory. We offer a full-time position in a professional but unpretentious working environment, where you will have the chance to take initiatives and see them come to fruition.

In addition, you can look forward to:

• A central role with great visibility and close collaboration with the factory's management.

• The opportunity to influence and further develop our integrated management system and EHS work.

• A collaborative environment with a focus on continuous improvement.

• A workplace certified as a Great Place to Work, where well-being and safety are a high priority.

Does this sound like your next job?

Send your application and CV as soon as possible by clicking 'Apply'. We process applications on an ongoing basis. For more information about us, visit our website at www.belden.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you have any questions? Contact Factory Manager Kim Fredriksen on tel. 93636200.

About Belden Cekan A/S

Since 1979, we have developed and manufactured network connectors and special machines. We are approximately 40 employees and have been Great Place to Work certified since 2021. We are part of Belden Inc., a global group with over 8,000 employees.

Read more about Belden Inc. on our website: https://www.belden.com/

Do you want to head up quality and food safety at Harboe’s production site in Skælskør? Do you possess a strong professional background within QA/QC, and are you motivated by driving a proactive quality culture in close collaboration with production? Then you might be the one we are looking for.

About us

Harboes Bryggeri produces and sells beer, soft drinks, and malt- and fruit-based ingredients and beverages. Production takes place at our breweries in Skælskør and at the fully owned Darguner Brauerei in Germany. Both sites produce and package beverages in glass, cans, and PET, while Dargun also handles draught beer. Malt-based ingredients and concentrates are produced in Skælskør.

Quality and food safety are fundamental to everything we do. The Quality Department plays a key role in ensuring compliance, maintaining high standards, and safeguarding product quality from raw material to finished goods.

The position and Key responsibilities

As Quality Manager, you will have overall responsibility for leading Harboe’s Quality Department and ensuring the effective operation, maintenance, and continuous alignment of our quality management system.

You will become a part of the Group Quality Team and report directly to the Plant Director in Skælskør, with a dotted line reference to the Director, R&D, ESG and Quality.

Your primary focus will be to lead and develop our QA and QC teams while ensuring that our quality and food safety standards are consistently implemented and maintained across the organisation. Through visible leadership and close collaboration with production and other key stakeholders, you will ensure that quality remains an integral part of daily operations.

Building on our existing quality management system, you will drive systematic and continuous quality improvements. The role covers in-house products, ingredients, raw materials, packaging materials, and quality-related activities throughout production. You will ensure compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements while ensuring that the quality function supports customer expectations and operational needs.

Main focus areas include:

• Leading and developing the Quality Department, including QA and QC teams, ensuring clear priorities, strong collaboration, and a high level of engagement.

• Ensuring effective implementation and maintenance of the quality management system (IPW), including compliance with standards such as IFS and FSSC 22000.

• Planning, conducting, and following up on internal and external audits, including training of the internal audit team in Skælskør.

• Maintaining close cooperation with production, including handling of deviations, root cause analysis, and follow-up on corrective actions.

• Ensuring professional handling of customer complaints, including documentation, investigation, and timely follow-up.

• Ensuring compliance with food legislation, regulatory requirements, and quality standards, including communication and documentation.

• Supporting supplier quality requirements, including hygiene standards and HACCP-based controls through training and monitoring.

"In Skælskør, we believe that world-class quality is built right on the production floor through strong relationships, transparency, and a shared mindset. As our new Quality Manager, you will not just be managing systems and compliance from an office—you will be a visible and motivating partner directly in our operations. If you are ready to take true ownership, inspire your team, and bridge the gap between regulatory standards and daily production practices, we can’t wait to welcome you on board."

– Plant Director, Mogens Auchenberg

About you

You are a strong and present leader with solid experience from QA/QC in a food or similar regulated industry (e.g. ingredients or pharma). You have hands-on experience with HACCP, GMP, and certifications such as IFS and FSSC 22000, and you are familiar with food legislation and regulatory requirements across markets.

You work in a structured and analytical way and are known for being proactive, resilient, and communicative. You are able to motivate and engage others and have a strong focus on collaboration and operational execution.

You ideally hold a relevant degree within Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a similar field.

Interested?

If you would like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Plant Director, Mogens Auchenberg at mau@harboe.com.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, CV, and any relevant supporting documents.

The first round of interviews will take place on 7 December 2026, followed by a second round on 14 December 2026. We kindly ask applicants to keep these dates available.

Harboes Bryggeri views diversity as a strength and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply.

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. **

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**

We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week. But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.

The Opportunity

Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for an engineer to join our team.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll help model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

What You Will Do

• 
Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.

• 
Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.

• 
Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.

• 
Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.

• 
Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.

• 
Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.

• 
Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• 
Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

What You Could Bring

• 
2+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.

• 
Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language.

• 
Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.

• 
Experience with API design and integrating with third-party APIs.

• 
Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.

• 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders.

• 
A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code.

• 
Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken.

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Join Charlie Tango, a specialised unit within KMD

Charlie Tango is a multidisciplinary consultancy within KMD, bringing together around 40 specialists across design, strategy, technology, AI and innovation.

Together, we combine Charlie Tango’s hands-on approach to design and innovation with KMD’s deep domain knowledge and experience developing critical digital solutions that help shape the future of society.

AI is transforming how we explore ideas, create experiences and build digital products. At the same time, growing complexity demands stronger design systems, smarter processes and a more systematic approach to design.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who is excited by both. Someone with excellent visual and UI design skills, a strong understanding of UX, and a genuine passion for design craft, combined with a deep interest in the systems, processes and practices that enable great design at scale.

Be part of our multidisciplinary design team

You will join our Product Design team, part of Charlie Tango’s Experience Design department of approximately 15 designers, spanning UX, Service Design, UI, Motion Design and Branding.Your primary focus will be on UI, interaction design and design systems, working closely with our Service & UX Design team, frontend developers and product owners.

Your role

As a Senior Product Designer, you will take a leading role in shaping digital products, experiences and the practices behind them. You will take ownership of the design process, working from user needs and business challenges through concepts, interactions and high-quality visual execution.

You are a hands-on designer who can navigate complex challenges, facilitate collaboration and advise clients on how to improve their design practices.

With a particular focus on Process Design, Design Systems, DesignOps and Accessibility, you will help organisations develop and implement better ways of working, while remaining closely involved in the design work itself.

Your work will typically include:

• Creating digital products and interfaces. Develop high-quality visual and interaction design, from concepts and prototypes to detailed UI and production-ready designs.

• Designing processes and ways of working. Map workflows, identify challenges and develop practical processes that improve collaboration, decision-making and delivery.

• Building and evolving Design Systems. Develop components, design standards and governance models, and help organisations implement and adopt them.

• Advancing DesignOps and Accessibility. Help clients establish effective design practices, accessibility standards and processes that support consistent, inclusive digital experiences.

• Facilitating and advising. Lead workshops, collaborate with stakeholders and translate complex needs into clear design directions and practical solutions.

• Exploring AI in design. Use AI-assisted tools and automation in your own work, experiment with new workflows and help clients identify opportunities to improve their design processes.

• Developing our design practice. Share knowledge, challenge existing methods and contribute to the development of our Experience Design team.

What you bring

We imagine you have 5+ years of relevant experience, ideally from a consultancy, agency or complex product organisation. You are first and foremost a skilled visual and digital product designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong UI craft, attention to detail and experience creating digital products and working with large-scale design systems.

In detail:

• Excellent visual and UI design skills, including typography, colour, layout, interaction patterns, prototyping and detailed interface design.

• A strong understanding of UX, user behaviour and the principles of human-centred design.

• A systematic and analytical mindset, with a genuine interest in Process Design, workflows and improving how teams work.

• Practical experience with Design Systems and DesignOps, including components, governance, implementation and cross-functional collaboration.

• Deep accessibility expertise, including WCAG and the ability to independently advise on inclusive design and its implementation.

• Strong facilitation and consultancy skills, with the confidence to work directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

• Advanced Figma skills, and an active interest in AI-assisted design workflows and emerging technologies.

• Excellent communication skills in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Why join Charlie Tango?

At Charlie Tango, you become part of a close-knit specialist environment with the reach and opportunities of a major technology organisation as part of KMD.

You will work on meaningful digital challenges across public and private sectors, including solutions that support essential functions in Danish society. You will collaborate with experienced designers, advisors and engineers in an environment that values craft, curiosity, precision and new ideas.

You will also join at a time when AI and emerging technologies are changing both what we design and how we design it, creating opportunities to explore new approaches and influence the future of our practice.

We offer a high degree of professional autonomy, varied challenges and opportunities for professional development and knowledge sharing.

You will be employed by KMD in a full-time position, based at Charlie Tango's office in Østerbro, Copenhagen, with a competitive salary package, pension and employee benefits in accordance with KMD's employment terms. You will report to the Head of Design.

Interested?

We would love to see how you think, how you work, what you have created and how you envision an AI-driven future.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so send us your CV (or LinkedIn profile) and a link to your portfolio, ideally including examples of digital product design as well as work involving Design Systems, Process Design, DesignOps or Accessibility.

Applications are handled through KMD's recruitment process. Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We welcome qualified candidates from different backgrounds and experiences.

Come help us design digital experiences that matter, and shape how we design them.

jobs.description:
Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind, as well as other non-hydro renewable initiatives like PV/Solar and batteries. We currently develop, construct and operate wind generation assets across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK.

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

We are looking for several Senior Project Engineers to strengthen our offshore transmission engineering capabilities within Business Area Wind, Offshore, Engineering.

We are seeking engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Offshore substations

• Onshore substations

• Offshore export cables

• Onshore export cables

We welcome engineers from all relevant disciplines across these scopes, with particular interest in HV and LV systems for onshore and offshore substations, and civil engineering for onshore substations and onshore export cable routes. Your assigned scope will reflect your background and experience.

You will take ownership of assigned engineering work packages, from FEED and tendering through delivery and handover.

In these roles, you will apply your experience to shape and challenge supplier solutions from the owner’s perspective, coordinate technical expertise and resolve delivery issues.

Within the project, you will report to the respective Package Manager and work autonomously within your assigned scope, drawing on technical specialists and collaborating with Interface Managers, Procurement and other project functions.

Your responsibilities:

• 
Deliver assigned engineering work packages in accordance with contractual requirements and project and contract milestones. Plan and coordinate activities, and monitor and report on safety, quality, progress and cost within your scope.

• 
Apply a systems engineering mindset so decisions within your scope support the performance, integration, optimisation and delivery of the overall transmission system—not individual contracts in isolation.

•

jobs.description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

• On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
• The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
• You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.
AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

• How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
• How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
• What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?
This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
• Other relevant documents
Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

• Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
• Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
• Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Causal inference jointly at the Pioneer Centre for SMARTBiomed and the Pioneer Center for AI
jobs.description:
A three-year position as Assistant Professor in causal inference jointly within The Pioneer Centre for SMARTBiomed and The Pioneer Center for AI to be employed at the Department of Public Health, University of Copenhagen. The position is available from 1 March 2027, with the exact start date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

About the Pioneer Centre for SMARTbiomed: The Pioneer Centre for Statistical and computational Methods for Advanced Research to Transform Biomedicine (SMARTBiomed) will support a critical mass of researchers who focus on method and software development for analysis and inference from massive human data, advancing applications in medicine. The Pioneer Centre for SMARTBiomed will leverage large-scale, multimodal biomedical data combined with focused innovation in statistical and computational methods including machine learning to advance our understanding, treatment, and prevention of human disease. More information can be found here: https://smartbiomed.dk/

About the Pioneer Center for AI: The Pioneer Centre for Artificial Intelligence focuses on fundamental research, and within an interdisciplinary framework, develops platforms, methods, and practices addressing society’s greatest challenges. Hosted by the University of Copenhagen’s Department of Computer Science, cooperating institutions, Denmark’s Technical University, IT University of Copenhagen, Aalborg University, and Aarhus University co-lead the efforts along with Director, Professor Serge Belongie. More information on the center can be found here: https://www.aicentre.dk/ 

Information about the Department of Public Health can be found at: https://publichealth.ku.dk/

Job description
A successful candidate will conduct causal methods research at an international level. In the position, the candidate will work with both Erin Gabriel, (Causality theme lead and Co-director of SMARTbiomed and Professor at the Department of Public Health) and Sebastian Weichwald (Causality co-lead at the Pioneer Center AI and Associate professor at the Department of Mathematics) and aid in the supervision of a joint PhD student. The position is meant to be a bridge between the two centers, in causality, a theme both centers share. Specifically

The responsibilities will primarily consist of:

• 
Manage their own academic research and administrative activities

• 
Conduct research in line with the overlapping goals of the two pioneer centers in causal inference

• 
Contribute to evolving the research priorities of the two pioneer centers

• 
Support the collaborative infrastructure of the two pioneer centers

• 
Lead research papers pertaining to their own work and collaborate in the preparation of research publications. Ensure that software research outputs are provided to ensure maximum utility.

• 
Be a part of the supervision of the associated joint PhD student

• 
Develop ideas for new research projects

• 
Present papers at conferences and public meetings

• 
Take part in research-based teaching

• 
Supervise students, research assistants and postdocs outside of the joint student associated with the position

• 
Applying for funding for the next stage of their career

• 
Contribute to the administrative activities of both centers as needed

• 
Participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors

Profile
The successful applicant should have a PhD in Applied math, Statistics, Biostatistics, Computer science or a closely related area (e.g., pure mathematics with work in computational biology). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Assessment of applicants 
General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation and societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit.

Place of employment
The Department of Public Health, University of Copenhagen.

Terms of employment
The employment as Assistant Professor is a full-time and fixed-term position for 3 years. Starting date is 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible hereafter.

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,993 DKK/approx. 5,349 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. 

Questions
For further information please contact Erin Gabriel by email: erin.gabriel@sund.ku.dk and Sebastian Weichwald email: sweichwald@math.ku.dk (using the subject prefix “[P41]”).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format. Additional documents will not be considered as part of the evaluation.

• 
Cover letter (Max 1 page): Stating at which level you are applying, substantiate your qualification for the position and your motivations.

• 
Curriculum vitae (Max 3 pages): including education, research experience, other relevant skills

• 
Complete list of publications and preprints.
Highlight up to two publications that are particularly representative of your research. For each, provide no more than two sentences explaining its significance to you and the field, and your specific contribution. The selected publications need not be your most highly cited.

• 
Research plan (Max 3 pages): Description of current and future research plans

• 
Teaching portfolio (max 3 pages): outlining teaching experience and teaching plans

• 
Diplomas: Master and PhD degree or equivalent. If you do not yet have a PhD diploma, please just upload a PDF stating your (expected) PhD date.

Application deadline: 10 December 2026, 23.59pm CET 

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the above mentioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed, each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You can read about the recruitment process at https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. 

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Moment Professionals is recruiting on behalf of FPRT a Strategic Projects & Business Operations Manager based in Vojens, Denmark. We are looking for a project manager with a consultant's or project developer's mindset, who takes ownership of cross-functional business projects, takes the first step in understanding and structuring an issue and brings the CEO clear recommendations. The role suits you if you want to build structure in a company that is being built right now, with pragmatic, lightweight project management appropriate for a greenfield environment.

Your everyday at FPRT

You report to the CEO and take over the project management of FPRT's business and corporate projects, which the CHRO carries today alongside HR. The role has no direct reports to begin with, and you work across most of the company, with the Chief Production Officer, the process engineers, production, data, finance, HR and supply chain, as well as external implementation partners and advisers. The CEO communicates briefly and precisely, often on chat, takes challenge well and builds the collaboration on trust. Your mandate grows as that trust grows.

In the first months the SAP implementation is the largest task. An external partner implements the system, and you are FPRT's internal business project lead for the implementation: you keep track of progress and next steps, translate operational needs into clear requirements together with the functional owners and drive the solution into daily use across production planning, stock management, logistics and the integration of the systems FPRT selects in this period. Next come warehouse and logistics, selected governance and cross-functional operating processes, and business cases, for example for a new factory. Along the way you coordinate grant applications, public funding submissions and bank and investor material with internal owners and external partners.

You take the first step in understanding and structuring an issue, identify what information and expertise are needed, and then involve the right people. When a financing partner sends a long list of questions with a 48-hour deadline, you draft the answers from the documents that exist, mark how certain each answer is and bring them to the CEO and the right colleagues for a short validation. You prepare decisions as options, risks, advantages and price on one page with a clear recommendation, and you escalate delays and unresolved risks with a recommendation of your own.

The role is based in Vojens. You have the flexibility to work from home when a task needs focus, and in intense project periods you are on site every day, sometimes for a month or more. English is used a lot in daily work, and Danish is preferred, since FPRT is building a company in Denmark. If your Danish is not fluent yet, the right competencies count most.

And then there are the benefits:

A central role close to the CEO with direct influence on how a new company is built, ownership of business systems, processes, funding and business cases from day one, a mandate that grows with the trust you build, a culture where challenge with facts is welcome, and flexibility to work from home when focus requires it.

To succeed in the role…

…you do not need to have carried the title project manager or to come from defence. What matters is that you take ownership of cross-functional business projects, structure an issue before you involve the right people, and give a firm recommendation with the reasoning behind it. You also take pride in:

• 
challenging the CEO and colleagues with arguments and keeping the dialogue constructive.

• 
finding the information yourself and knowing when to escalate.

• 
keeping project management agile, with the minimum structure that makes it work.

• 
working with a risk until it is reduced, once you have identified it.

• 
involving busy colleagues firmly and kindly, so they like working with you.

What you need to bring:

• 
Either a relevant degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering management or a related field, or equivalent experience, and at least five years of relevant experience or a strong track record of cross-functional business projects.

• 
Basic project management skills, including stakeholder management and risk assessment, gained through education or practice.

• 
Experience as business project lead or coordinator on an ERP or other business-system implementation. Method and implementation experience matter more than specialist system knowledge.

• 
Executive-level communication in English, written and spoken: short, clear and decision-oriented.

• 
The possibility to be on site in Vojens every day in intense periods.

It is an advantage if you:

• 
come from management consulting or advisory, for example an audit and advisory firm such as the Big 4, or from business transformation, corporate development or strategy and operations in a scale-up.

• 
have worked with grant applications, public funding, or bank and investor material.

• 
have prepared business cases and cost-benefit analyses for executive decisions.

• 
speak Danish.

The company

FirePoint Rocket Technology (FPRT) is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark: a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. FPRT's ambition is significant: the company is scaling from the early operational phase to 300+ employees within the next 18 months. Joining FPRT now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.

**Why we are hiring

With growth comes friction. Deals and tenders are tracked in different places, the numbers in the CRM do not always match what we bill, and it takes too much effort to answer simple questions like “what will we close this quarter?”

We want one person to own the engine behind our revenue: the CRM, the data, and the path a customer takes from first contact to signed deal, onboarding and correct billing. That is this role. You will make work easier for our sales, marketing, onboarding and customer success teams, and you will give leadership numbers they can trust.

**The team

**What You Will Do

• Set up and improve lead routing

• Bring in the other tools the commercial team needs, such as order management, bid management and lead development

**Planning and sales process

• Support territory design and regional planning reviews

• Run capacity modelling and lead quota planning

• Improve the path from lead to opportunity

**What Success Looks Like After Your First Year

• Leadership opens one dashboard and trusts what it sees

• Every deal and tender lives in HubSpot, and CRM data matches billing data

• The weekly forecast is a habit, and it gets more accurate over time

• Every market follows the same sales process

• Our sales team spends less time on admin and more time with customers

**What You Bring

• 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or commercial analytics in a B2B SaaS company

• Strong CRM administration skills, ideally in HubSpot

• A track record of building tools and processes that help a sales organisation work better

• Comfort with data: Excel, SQL, or BI tools such as Tableau

• A good understanding of SaaS business models and unit economics

• Hands-on experience bringing AI tools into a sales or marketing team

• Fluent English. Another European language, such as German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Danish or Italian, is a big plus

• A degree in business, engineering or a similar field, or equivalent experience

**Who You Are

**

• You enjoy building things from the ground up, and you are comfortable when not everything is defined yet

• You take ownership and follow through

• You can think big picture and still roll up your sleeves to fix a workflow yourself

• You explain data clearly, whether you are talking to a sales rep or to the leadership team

• You like working with people from many countries and cultures

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.
